slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years Driving Software, DevOps & AI-Enabled Transformation
slides.n: Meet Mayur Saxena, a PMP-certified engineering leader with 21 years of experience building high-performing teams and delivering enterprise-scale products. {His} recent focus has been on driving agentic AI transformation across engineering organizations.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, drove upgrade enhancements reducing upgrade time by ~90%, and led AI agent development that resolved 100+ long-lived customer defects and CVEs.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led Webex developer experience team, architecting AWS-hosted distributed services enabling Webex Calling and Meetings integration with Microsoft Teams using Kafka, Redis, and Java.
Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led Kubernetes-native release and CI/CD engineering using Jenkins, Docker and OpenStack, successfully managing 10+ major and 30+ minor product releases.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Owned functional and regression testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway VOIP gateway, driving test automation coverage toward 100% and handling protocol-level customer escalations.
Verizon India · May 2007-Mar 2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow functionality and regression testing for IP-converged contact center solutions covering IVR, call routing, and prepaid dialing.
slides.n: {His} career spans from hands-on QA and protocol testing to leading large engineering teams at Cisco and F5. Along the way, {he} moved from individual contributor to team lead to engineering manager, consistently driving major release delivery, platform modernization, and now AI-enabled transformation.

items: VOIP & Security Protocols (SIP, H323, RTP, SDP)
slides.n: Mayur brings a rare blend of deep technical expertise and leadership skill—spanning agentic AI and GenAI tooling, cloud-native DevOps practices, core programming, VOIP protocols, and PMP-certified program management.

Across {his} career, Mayur has delivered measurable impact—cutting upgrade time by roughly 90 percent, resolving over 100 long-lived customer defects and CVEs, and successfully shipping dozens of major and minor product releases.

Mayur continually invests in {his} own growth, from a foundational engineering degree to a PMP certification and a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin.

slides.s: Let's connect and build the future of AI-driven engineering together
slides.n: Thank you for learning about Mayur Saxena's journey—from protocol testing to leading agentic AI transformation across global engineering teams. {He} looks forward to connecting and exploring new opportunities to drive innovation together.
